entries.name: android-log-analysis
entries.description: Analyze logs captured from Android devices (logcat, dmesg, bugreport, tombstone, pstore, crashdump, dumpsys, etc.) to reconstruct event timelines, identify anomalies, and perform root cause analysis. Optionally correlates with AOSP-derived source code when invoked from a source tree. Use when the user provides Android device logs and asks for log analysis, timeline reconstruction, anomaly detection, crash analysis, or mentions 日志分析, 时空链, 异常分析, tombstone, bugreport, crashdump, ANR, or panic.

entries.name: calculator
entries.description: 计算数学表达式并进行单位换算。支持算术、百分比、乘方，以及常见单位换算（温度、距离、重量）。无外部依赖。

entries.name: code-review
entries.description: Perform Bytello C++ code reviews with findings-first output. ALWAYS use this skill when users ask for 代码评审/CR/review/check changes in C/C++ projects, and MUST fully read coding-rules/for-human/cpp/README.md and coding-rules/for-human/project/README.md before producing any findings.

entries.name: es-log-query
entries.description: ES Log Query - 生产环境 Elasticsearch 日志查询工具，支持关系表达式查询条件和 search_after 分页

entries.name: requirement-spec
entries.description: 需求规格引导技能。当用户说"写需求文档"、"整理需求"、"我要开发一个功能"、"需求初稿转标准文档"、"帮我把这个需求理清楚"等类似表达时触发。通过通俗对话逐项确认所有要点，产出一份完整、成体系的需求文档，供后续建模/开发直接使用。本技能只做引导与产出，不创建模型、不写代码、不发布。
